source_refs.note: Book p. 52: 2.10.1 definition of global (absolute) maximum and maximum value

blocks.text: Ab hum sab se pehle global (absolute) maximum ki baat karte hain. Global ka matlab hai "poore ka poora": yani poore interval ki sab values ko dekh kar jo sab se bari ho. Jaise poori class mein sab se zyada number lene wala student: us ka muqabla har student se hai, sirf apne bench walon se nahin.

Kitab ki definition: maan lijiye \(I\) ek interval hai aur \(f: I \to \mathbb{R}\) ek function hai. Hum kehte hain ke \(f\) ka \(x = c \in I\) par global (absolute) maximum hai, agar \(I\) ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(c) \ge f(x)\).
Agar \(f(x)\) ka \(x = c\) par global (absolute) maximum ho, to \(f(c)\) ko function ki global (absolute) maximum value kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Definition ko ek muqable ki tarah parhiye: \(f(c)\) ka muqabla interval ki har value \(f(x)\) se hai, aur woh kabhi haarta nahin (barabar ho sakta hai, is liye \(\ge\) hai). Phir \(c\) woh jagah hai jahan maximum aata hai, aur \(f(c)\) maximum value hai. Do alag cheezein: ek "kahan", doosri "kitna".
Interval bohat ahem hai. \([0, 2]\) par \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ki global maximum value \(f(2) = 4\) hai (2.10.2, Example (a)); lekin \((-\infty, \infty)\) par isi function ka koi global maximum nahin, kyun ke \(x\) barhane se values bina had ke barhti jati hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(f(x) = 4 - x^{2}\), poori real line par.
\(x^{2}\) kabhi negative nahin hota, yani \(x^{2} \ge 0\). Is liye 4 mein se hamesha koi non-negative cheez minus ho rahi hai: \(f(x) = 4 - x^{2} \le 4 = f(0)\), har \(x\) ke liye.
Natija: \(f\) ka global (absolute) maximum \(x = 0\) par hai, aur global maximum value \(f(0) = 4\) hai. Graph ek ulta parabola hai jis ki chotti \((0, 4)\) par hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(f(x) = \sin x\) ki global maximum value kya hai, aur kahan aati hai? (Jawab: value 1 hai, kyun ke \(\sin x \le 1\) hamesha. Yeh \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par aati hai, aur har \(2\pi\) baad dobara: \(\frac{\pi}{2} + 2k\pi\). Yani maximum value ek hai magar maximum ke points bohat se ho sakte hain.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(c\) par global maximum: interval ke har \(x\) ke liye \(f(c) \ge f(x)\).
2. \(f(c)\) global maximum value hai; \(c\) woh point hai jahan yeh aati hai.
3. Jawab interval par munhasir hai; mumkin hai function ka global maximum ho hi na.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sawal maximum value \(f(c)\) pooche aur jawab mein sirf \(x = c\) likh dena, ya ulta.
2. Sirf chand values check kar ke faisla kar lena: inequality interval ke har ek \(x\) ke liye sach honi chahiye.
